Hi, I'm the developer at GYUFORGE.
I've released this 3D physics puzzle on Android: throw marbles at toy buildings and sculptures, and reach each stage's collapse target before running out of throws.

You can adjust the height and add spin to a shot, aim for a support, or throw over an obstacle.
Glass shatters, wood splits, and rubber bounces, so the material changes how a shot plays out.

Google Play (Android 10+): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gyuforge.rumblorb

Gameplay preview, recorded before the Android release:

There's also a launch code: BALLIN.
It gives you one My Ball creation ticket and one change ticket, so you can make a custom marble and edit it later.
Limited to the first 500 accounts, once per account, until October 31, 2026 at 7:59:59 AM PDT, or until all claims are used.
